title: 第1356章 规矩第1355章 红白印
slug: 九叔系统道术给我全加满
content_zh:
黑水集第二灯口，和任府后门纸口，可能是同一路。
一边压住，一边就往别处找口。
这说明青丹主残余的口路，还在流。
而且它在找熟人、找门神、找门边纸。
这条线不能再拖。
必须继续查根。
但掌门没让他参详。
所以，他只能把新发现写成“流口法”。
林凡提笔写下。
流口法。
一，口路不止一处，可借熟声、门边纸、神像嘴、风口。
二，黑纸裂、纸边红、门缝白，皆可能为口头。
三，口不答，则声退。
四，口先借人，再借门，再借神。
五，门神纸边最要紧，不可轻剥。
六，熟声最易乱心，须先判真假。
七，夜里有人喊门，不许先开口。
写完，他顿了一下。
又补一句。
八，若声换熟人，先看其是否知镇中旧规。

九，真熟人会先守规，不会急催开门。
九叔看完，点头。
“这个可以给各地义庄。”
顾安也道：“对。”
“以后遇到口路，先判规矩。”
“真熟人会守规。”
林凡放下笔。
门外那道声音已经彻底没了。
但这件事说明，四号地的灯路，开始往任家镇外扩。
或者说，青丹主在把黑水集和任家镇重新串起来。
这样不行。
林凡心里已经有了清楚判断。
只靠守，不够。
还得查流口的源头。
黑水集那盏第二灯，必须彻底封掉。
可现在不能参详太深。
只能等掌门那边。
夜里。
九叔让所有人轮守。
文才和黄老板一组。

秋生和林凡一组。
content_en:
The second lamp outlet in Heishuiji and the paper outlet at the back door of Ren Mansion may be on the same road.
While suppressing it, he looked for an outlet elsewhere.
This shows that the remaining words of Lord Qing Dan are still flowing.
And it is looking for acquaintances, door gods, and door signs.
This line cannot be dragged any longer.
We must continue to investigate the root cause.
But the boss didn't let him know the details.
Therefore, he could only write down his new discoveries as "spoken words".
Lin Fan picked up his pen and wrote.
Drooling method.
1. There is more than one place for speech. You can use familiar voices, paper on the edge of the door, the mouth of a god, or the vent of the wind.
Second, cracked black paper, red edges, and white cracks on the door could all be caused by words.
Third, if you don’t answer, your voice will fade away.
Fourth, the mouth first borrows from people, then from the door, and then from God.
Five, the edge of the door god paper is the most important and should not be peeled off lightly.
6. Familiar sounds are most likely to disturb the mind, so you must first determine whether they are true or false.
7. If someone calls at the door at night, you are not allowed to speak first.
After writing, he paused.
One more sentence.
8. If you call someone you know, first check to see if they know the old rules of the town.
9. A true acquaintance will obey the rules first and will not rush to open the door.
Uncle Jiu nodded after reading it.
"This can be given to charity villages in various places."
Gu An also said: "Yes."
"In the future, when encountering a quarrel, decide the rules first."
“Real acquaintances follow the rules.”
Lin Fan put down his pen.
The sound outside the door has completely disappeared.
But this incident shows that the light road in No. 4 is beginning to expand outside Renjia Town.
In other words, Master Qing Dan is reconnecting Heishuiji and Renjia Town.
This won't work.
Lin Fan already made a clear judgment in his mind.
Simply relying on defense is not enough.
The source of the drool must also be investigated.
The second light in the Black Water Collection must be completely blocked.
But we can’t go into too much detail now.
We can only wait for the leader.
at night.
Uncle Jiu asked everyone to take turns guarding.
Wencai and Boss Huang are in a group.
Qiu Sheng and Lin Fan were in a group.
